title: ctenitis exaggerata
intro: Ctenitis exaggerata, commonly known as the Asian polypody, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis exaggerata include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
